name: Box Split
description: A Shikaku-style logic puzzle. Split the grid into boxes: each box holds one number and covers that many squares. From counting squares at 5 to expert 12×12 grids and speed solves, with area, times facts and logic rules along the way.
author: Koda Math Lab
tagline: Split the grid. Every box matches its number.

features.name: Play together
features.description: Friends race the same lesson with the same puzzles. XP and stars still come from each child's own answers.

features.name: Spoken voice
features.description: Reads the lesson prompt aloud. Turn off for a silent lesson.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Plays a short sound when a box is drawn, and when a box is right or wrong.

features.name: Haptic vibration
features.description: Adds a small vibration when a box is right or wrong.

features.name: Drag to draw
features.description: Lets children drag from corner to corner to draw a box. Turn off to draw by tapping two corners only.

settingsSchema.label: Speech rate
settingsSchema.help: How fast Koda reads the prompt aloud.
